absent: Exact numeric encodings for snapshot faithfulness and state flags, poison pattern, folio size limits, huge page sizes, masks and frame constants.
Locking, interrupt, sleep and calling context requirements for dump, snapshot and poison helpers.
Complete memory layouts of page, folio, snapshot, range, space, merge and iterator structures beyond fields observed in diagnostics.
Semantics, failure modes and return contracts of folio, page and cache helpers invoked during capture and tests.
Boot option registration, invocation timing and interaction with other debug controls, plus overall self test driver sequencing and reporting.
Lifetime, ownership and reclamation rules for deposited spare tables and architectural translation cache maintenance guarantees for access updates.
Behavior for invalid frames, absent pages, null contexts and malformed inputs not exercised in the fragments.

findings.text: Diagnostic reporting entry points cover single pages, address ranges, address spaces, merge requests and iterator trees, emitting low level logs for post mortem analysis.
Support helpers provide best effort capture of page and folio state plus boot controlled filling of page storage to surface use of uninitialised structures.
Generic table helpers update leaf access state with change reporting and maintain the queue of spare tables associated with transparent huge entries.

Test context aggregates owning address space and range, live pointers for each table level, saved starting tables, target address and protections, contiguity and frame inputs, fixed alignment and frame values for repeatable construction, and swap representations.
Iterator position exposes an inclusive start address and an exclusive end derived from underlying ordered container cursor state.

Merge request state observed by diagnostics comprises owning space, file offset, iterator, neighbouring and target ranges, new bounds and flags, backing file and sharing structures, policy and naming handles, fault handling context, a state code, expansion intent and flags recording which neighbours were adjusted or removed.

Address space summary observed by diagnostics comprises task limit, mapping bases, top table, usage counters, table bytes, map count, high water and current usage statistics, code data break stack and argument environment bounds, format handler, flag bitmaps, executable handle and optional asynchronous, accounting, notification, balancing and flush state.

Capture records frame number, assumes faithful state, copies folio and page storage, derives head and member position for both plain and compound encodings, validates position against folio size with a small bounded number of recaptures, and otherwise degrades to a cleared single entry marked unfaithful.
Snapshot flags preserve buddy membership even when only the head of a high order free block carries the marker and preserve idle state observed on the folio.

Page reporting distinguishes poisoned storage from normal state, optionally annotates a caller reason and then chains to owner reporting, while merge reporting tolerates absent top level and absent members and recursively reports present space and neighbours plus optionally the iterator tree.
Table self test logging prefixes each message with a module tag and the calling function name.

Access updates compare the installed entry with the desired entry, install and maintain translation caches only when different, and report whether a change occurred, with the huge level additionally requiring huge aligned addresses.

Deposited spare tables form a first in first out queue anchored at the huge entry, where deposit publishes the newest table at the head and withdrawal returns the head and advances anchoring to the next link.

Basic flag checks cover identity, age, dirtiness and writability transitions including variants without range context, huge entries must classify as unsuitable as tables and as leaves, middle and upper huge tests are skipped without transparent huge capability and collapse to empty definitions when levels are folded or unsupported.

Advanced checks progress through install with cache maintenance, transition to read only and verify, clear and verify empty, reinstall clean read only then upgrade to writable dirty through access update and verify, exercise age clearing, and finally clear again with huge levels aligning addresses and bracketing work with deposit and withdrawal of spare tables.
Deposit and withdrawal of spare huge tables require the caller to hold the lock protecting the huge entry, verified through an assertion on the associated lock pointer.

Boot option handling defaults page structure filling to enabled, treats missing value as request to enable all, a leading dash as disable, a specific letter as enable with warnings for unknown letters, and the fill helper only writes the poison pattern when enabled.

Unsynchronised copying of compound page state can observe torn head, position or size values, so callers must handle an explicit unfaithful outcome signalled by flags and a mismatch warning rather than trusting the copies.
Test support defines a small non zero value constrained to the lowest eight bits.

Range reporting includes identity, start and end, owning space, protection, sharing and operation handles, file offset and backing, private data, reference count when per range locking applies, and flag decoding.
